style: Bold clean cartoon illustration for an educational history animation: thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors with soft shading, slightly stylized but historically accurate details.
sheetRules: Pure plain white background. Exactly {n} separate items arranged in a neat grid of {cols} columns and {rows} rows, each item fully visible and clearly separated by empty white space, none touching or overlapping. Every item seen from the side, facing right, at the same scale. No text, labels, numbers, logos or ground shadows. No extra items.
bgRules: Wide 16:9 background scene for an animation, side view at eye level, no people, no animals, no vehicles unless listed, no text. Leave the lower third fairly open as a ground area where characters can stand.
